title: 2.1.22 Write Your First Ternary
description: Use the conditional operator ? to assign one of two values to a variable. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Declare isMember
steps.instructions: Create a variable called isMember and set it to true.

steps.title: Use a ternary to set discount
steps.instructions: Create a variable called discount. Use the ternary operator so discount is 20 when isMember is true, and 0 otherwise. Log discount.

requirements.title: ternary on isMember yields 20 : 0
requirements.description: A ternary references isMember and chooses between 20 and 0, in that order. Help: 2.1.20 (The Conditional Operator ?)

requirements.title: discount assigned from the isMember ternary
requirements.description: discount is assigned using a ternary on isMember. Help: 2.1.20 (The Conditional Operator ?)

requirements.title: discount is logged
requirements.description: console.log is called with the discount variable. Help: 2.1.20 (The Conditional Operator ?)

Mark a criterion missing only when the idea is absent or the code does the opposite. Code inside a comment never runs. Write each note for THIS student's own code: in a not-met note, name the exact line or name in their code that causes the problem (quote at most a few words of it), say in plain words what it does now versus what the criterion needs, and give one concrete next thing to try, but do NOT write the corrected code. In a met note, say in one short phrase what in their code satisfied it. Do not use generic praise.
